sections.Profile:
The "Charlie's Angels" pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in November 1978, is based on the popular TV series of the same name. Designed by Allen Edwall with artwork by Gordon Morison, it features the likenesses of the show's stars: Cheryl Ladd, Kate Jackson, and Jaclyn Smith.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, 1970s, Solid State
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Allen Edwall
- Art: Gordon Morison
